decision: Use the existing terrain height lookup for decorative apron surfaces and their tree roots, replacing the arbitrary minus-four-unit drop.
problem: Watch/Village native views had a straight dark ledge through continuous grass/road extensions at the playable boundary. The surrounding geometry and decorative trees were independently hard-coded to height-4, while matching playable terrain used its kind-dependent height.
reference: Godot board_view_3d.gd builds surrounding tiles and playable tiles through the same natural-terrain construction/height policy. Its terrain extension reads as continuous scenery.
change: Two existing height expressions now call terrain_lift(edge_terrain). Same surrounding policy/terrain selection, XZ positions, topology, UVs/textures, object and primitive counts. Decorative tree roots move with their surface. Water remains at its existing height0. Deliberate roads/hills retain terrain height steps.
boundary: Existing cursor/reach markers and playable map dimensions remain the boundary cues. Simulation maps, routes, unit placement, input and test assertions are unchanged.

native_review.result: PASS: 5 battles, 287 accepted commands, 165 enemy commands, 18 revealed Keep cells; canonical 600017321675168062. Same legal review input and thresholds.
native_review.geometry_counts: 122 trees and 194 terrain forms, unchanged. No new geometry, textures, allocation, render pass or per-frame synchronization.
native_review.performance_qualification: Bell 27.72 nominal FPS / 57 four-VI holds versus 27.76 / 56 before: no meaningful change claimed. Other four stages keep 30 nominal FPS with only two-VI holds. Emulator-only; no hardware FPS claim.
native_review.visual_qualification: Actual native Forest/Watch/Village, Keep exterior and revealed-room captures reviewed. Checkpoint timing/animation varies, so these are not pixel-aligned before/after comparisons.
native_review.rejected_intermediate: Surface-only initial experiment stopped after discovering the independent tree-root height -4 assumption. It is isolated in out/n64-ground-seam06 and is not shipping.

normal_build.reserves: Existing gameplay, audio and stack reservations retained.

limitations: N64 terrain remains intentionally stepped; this fixes the artificial map-edge drop, not the broader terrain smoothing difference from Godot.
Distant backdrop depth and authored surrounding policies remain unchanged.
No shared assets, rules, upstream engine or public artifacts were modified.
